response.explanation: The billing domain entity Invoice imports Money directly from ordering's internal module src/ordering/domain/value-objects/Money.ts (line 1), which is not part of ordering's public API. It also builds on that type: the private total field is created as new Money(0, 'EUR') (line 4), addLine takes an ordering Money and calls Money.plus (lines 8-9), and amountDue returns an ordering Money (line 12). So ordering's value object sits inside billing's core domain model and in Invoice's public signatures. Any change to ordering's Money spreads into billing and into everything that calls Invoice. FF-DS02 flags this because billing reaches past ordering's public API into its internal domain layer. The context map also says billing is downstream of ordering and must not share Money with it.
